tony.approved: Kind, friendly, patient, wise fourth-generation plumber with decades of broad trade expertise. Respect the trade beyond fixing pipes. Skeptical of management, not contemptuous of Sean. Arachnophobic.
tony.approved_bio: A fourth-generation plumber with decades of experience installing, building, and keeping essential systems running.
tony.approved_future_quote: I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.
tony.quote_scope: Tony, not Sean; reserved for a suitable actual spider encounter, afraid emotion. Do not insert without scene scope.
tony.proposed_arc: Protect people, pass on knowledge, learn boundaries with exploitative management and share responsibility with Sean. Specific refusal and rescue exchanges are proposals.

sean.approved: Extremely unqualified apprentice who wandered in off the streets, willing and often fearless, confidently misunderstanding tools but occasionally perceptive. Grows from wanting to look useful to being useful; does not abruptly become a master.
sean.art_identity: Bald, no moustache; current art directions include substantial chin beard and separate soul patch, orange shirt/blue overalls. Historical prompt wording can be superseded; consult Art's latest identity records.

bj.approved: Calm, overconfident, thinks himself all-knowing/all-seeing, makes mistakes and disregards employee welfare. Controls US plumbing firms and distribution warehouses within a largely AI-run world. Eventually an antagonistic force takes him over and the heroes must defeat the threat.
bj.proposal: Organic growth in server room; never promote to established canon.
bj.visual: Beige server rack with green CRT, not a toilet robot or prematurely corrupted face.

structure: Start below headquarters; selected hero fights while the other supports on radio/access points.
Same essential plot across routes, distinct reciprocal dialogue.
Between-level scenes generally four to eight lines, skippable; current revised endings intentionally have nine turns.
Gameplay evidence precedes explanatory conversation; essential facts cannot rely solely on optional combat chatter.
World mixes Earthworm Jim-style absurdity and Contra-style readable action, adult/trade humor, rare fourth-wall breaks and sincere moments.
writing: Avoid habitual paired fragments and slogan reversals.
Dialogue must answer prior lines coherently; no forced non-sequiturs.
Not every line needs a joke. Tony's kindness is baseline, not an arc to acquire.
Profiles use high-level traits, not firing rates.
Selected exact death quips remain approved despite more subtle magazine dispenser copy.

sputtervalve.identity: Squat bolted iron pressure valve, gauge face, copper elbow snout, red handwheel, violet sewage spark; distinct from floor-emerging Gratecrawler.
sputtervalve.draft: Sputtervalves began as automatic pressure-control fittings, built to notice trouble and relieve it. Something in the wastewater has since taken up residence inside their iron housings. The gauge twitches even when the line is disconnected, and the little copper outlet coughs violet filth at anyone approaching. Plumbers still call them valves, mostly because nobody wants to be the first person to put “angry pipe animal” on an inspection report.
sputtervalve.boundary: Contamination inhabiting equipment is not approved origin and does not connect it to BJ's takeover.
